# SPF API headers

The headers in `Include/SPF/SPF_API` are from
[TrackAndTruckDevs/SPF-Framework](https://github.com/TrackAndTruckDevs/SPF-Framework),
commit `4b054b63d89b116a963f6913058cc57c0c6c65f2`.

They are used only to build the optional `PrismCameraBridge.dll` companion.
The upstream Apache-2.0 license is preserved in this directory.
